dz: 巴达斯·普克斯(Bardas Phokas the Younger)在阿比多斯之战中被击毙,结束了他第二次对拜占庭皇帝巴西尔二世的叛乱.
de: The death of Bardas Phokas the Younger in the battle of Abydos ends his second rebellion against Byzantine Emperor Basil II.
